mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as saContractorName, c2.C_Name as saSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saCostConsultName, c1.C_Abbreviation as saContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as saSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as saCostConsultAbbName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Type as conType, con.Con_Code as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Settlement_Apply mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sa_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sa_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Sa_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Con_Id = #{conId} and mn.Sa_State=7 order by mn.Sa_State_Time desc limit 1

select c1.C_Name as saContractorName, c2.C_Name as saSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saCostConsultName, c1.C_Abbreviation as saContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as saSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as saCostConsultAbbName, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Name else con.con_Name end as conName, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Money else con.con_Money_Total end as conMoneyTotal, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Type else con.con_Type end as conType, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Code else con.con_Code end as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Project_Stage as pProjectStage, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Settlement_Apply mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sa_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sa_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Sa_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Subcontract_Record sr on mn.Con_Id=sr.Sc_Id where mn.Sa_Id = #{saId}

select c1.C_Name as saContractorName, c2.C_Name as saSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as saCostConsultName, c1.C_Abbreviation as saContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as saSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as saCostConsultAbbName, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Name else con.con_Name end as conName, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Money else con.con_Money_Total end as conMoneyTotal, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Type else con.con_Type end as conType, case when mn.Sa_Is_Sub_Contract='02' then sr.Sc_Code else con.con_Code end as conCode, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Project_Stage as pProjectStage, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, mn.* from Inv_Settlement_Apply mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Sa_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Sa_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Sa_Cost_Consult = c3.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Subcontract_Record sr on mn.Con_Id=sr.Sc_Id where mn.P_Id = #{projectId} and mn.Sa_State = 7

select mn.*,ccc.confirm_serial_number as confirmSerialNumber ,sc3.C_NAME as constructionContractorName ,ccc.Construction_Image as constructionImage ,ccc.Construction_Drawing as constructionDrawing ,mr.Mr_Report_Amount_Pre as mrReportAmountPre ,ccc.Audit_Unit as auditUnit ,sc2.C_NAME as auditUnitName, mr.P_NAME as pName from Inv_Settlement_Apply mn left join construction_completion_confirm ccc on ccc.id = mn.completion_confirm_id left join maintenance_record mr on mr.Mr_Id = mn.mr_id left join sys_company sc3 on sc3.C_ID = ccc.Construction_Contractor left join sys_company sc2 on sc2.C_ID = ccc.Audit_Unit where mn.Sa_Id = #{saId}
